requirements.rationale: The work is built in Python with PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, ChromaDB and scikit-learn, trained on a Google Colab A100. A garbage-classification model using ResNet34 transfer learning reached 94% accuracy over 2,527 images in six classes, with 100% recall on the minority class, which held only 137 images.
